sections.text: Global oil markets have been extremely volatile this quarter with the benchmark crude price swinging between $72 and $94 per barrel. In addition, our primary lubricant supplier, ChemSupply Ltd, experienced a production disruption at their Texas facility, causing a two-week interruption in deliveries. We have activated alternative sourcing through Gulf Coast Distributors.
